body.p: An apparatus includes a capture device and a processor. The capture device may be configured to generate pixel data corresponding to an exterior view from a vehicle. The processor may be configured to perform operations on video frames generated from the pixel data to detect a moving object in the video frames, determine a predicted path of the moving object, determine a probability of the moving object colliding with the vehicle based on the predicted path, determine whether the vehicle is stationary and generate a control signal if the vehicle is stationary and the probability is greater than a pre-determined threshold. The
control signal may be configured to enable a response to alert a person in control of the moving object.
